structured.answer: I won't decide alone. The page says פסגות is cheapest (about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, using 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month at 7%) with the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". But I don't know פסגות, so I'd lean to Leumi (83,396 ₪) and ask my son first.

stuck.why: The word מדד means the price index to me, and the buttons are in English letters (MSCI, S&P 500). I nearly left.
I didn't know if the 7% is promised or only an example, so I don't know if the final sums are real.

stuck.where: Screen 3–4, choosing between פסגות and לאומי
stuck.why: The top name is a company I've never heard of. The bank I trust is second, so I couldn't decide.

stuck.where: Screen 6, Interactive Brokers / iShares … UCITS ETF
stuck.why: Foreign names and English letters. I got tired here and stopped.
